documents.title: Authentication User Stories
documents.content:
### Story: User Login
**As a** registered user
**I want** to log in with my email and password
**So that** I can access my personalized dashboard

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I am on the login page, When I enter valid credentials, Then I am redirected to my dashboard
- Given I enter invalid credentials, When I submit, Then I see an error message 'Invalid email or password'
- Given I fail 3 login attempts, When I try again, Then my account is locked for 15 minutes

**Priority:** High
**Story Points:** 5

documents.title: E-Commerce Cart Stories
documents.content:
### Story: Add Item to Cart
**As a** shopper
**I want** to add products to my shopping cart
**So that** I can purchase multiple items in one transaction

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I am viewing a product, When I click 'Add to Cart', Then the item appears in my cart with quantity 1
- Given an item is in my cart, When I add the same item again, Then the quantity increases by 1
- Given my cart has items, When I view the cart, Then I see total price calculated correctly

**Priority:** High
**Story Points:** 3

### Story: Update Cart Quantity
**As a** shopper
**I want** to modify quantities in my cart
**So that** I can adjust my order before checkout

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I have items in cart, When I change quantity, Then subtotal updates immediately
- Given I set quantity to 0, When I confirm, Then item is removed from cart
- Given item has max stock of 10, When I try to add 15, Then quantity is capped at 10 with message

documents.title: API User Stories Pattern
documents.content:
### Story: Create Resource via API
**As a** developer using the API
**I want** to create new resources via POST endpoint
**So that** I can programmatically manage data

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given valid JSON payload, When I POST to /api/resources, Then I receive 201 Created with resource ID
- Given missing required fields, When I POST, Then I receive 400 Bad Request with field errors
- Given duplicate unique field, When I POST, Then I receive 409 Conflict
- Given I'm not authenticated, When I POST, Then I receive 401 Unauthorized

**Priority:** High
**Story Points:** 5

**Technical Notes:**
- Validate input against JSON schema
- Return Location header with new resource URL
- Include created_at timestamp in response

documents.title: Requirements Prioritization Framework
documents.content:
## MoSCoW Prioritization for User Stories

**Must Have (P1):**
- Core functionality without which product cannot launch
- Security and compliance requirements
- Performance baseline requirements

**Should Have (P2):**
- Important features that add significant value
- Features that improve user experience significantly
- Integrations with key systems

**Could Have (P3):**
- Nice-to-have features
- Enhancements to existing functionality
- Advanced customization options

**Won't Have (P4):**
- Features deferred to future releases
- Low-value additions
- Experimental features

## Story Point Estimation Guide
- 1 point: Simple change, < 2 hours
- 2 points: Small feature, 2-4 hours
- 3 points: Medium feature, 1 day
- 5 points: Larger feature, 2-3 days
- 8 points: Complex feature, 1 week
- 13 points: Epic-sized, needs splitting

lessons_learned.title: Vague Acceptance Criteria Lead to Rework
lessons_learned.lesson: Always write acceptance criteria with specific, measurable outcomes. Avoid words like 'quickly', 'easily', 'user-friendly' without concrete metrics. Example: Instead of 'page loads quickly', write 'page loads in under 2 seconds at p95'.
lessons_learned.prevention: Use Given-When-Then format and include specific numbers, error messages, and edge cases.

lessons_learned.title: Missing Edge Cases Cause Production Bugs
lessons_learned.lesson: Stories without edge case criteria often result in incomplete implementations. Always consider: empty states, maximum limits, concurrent access, network failures, invalid input.
lessons_learned.prevention: Add a 'Edge Cases' section to every user story with at least 3 edge cases.

lessons_learned.title: Story Dependencies Not Documented
lessons_learned.lesson: When stories depend on other stories or external systems, failing to document this leads to blocked sprints and incorrect estimates.
lessons_learned.prevention: Add 'Dependencies' and 'Blocked By' fields to every story. Include API contracts, database migrations, and third-party integrations.
